intro: Biggest rank disagreements between the SEI board and SP+, 2026 season: from the SP+ top 15 and from our own top 15.

teams.explanation: The win column is doing work the play data won't back: +108 (margin #14) after blowouts over Cincinnati (34-7) and Iowa State (39-3), but SEI's Arizona defense sits at #66 — opponents score TDs on 20% of red-zone trips and Arizona's sack rate (5.1%, z -1.16) threatens nobody. The offense turns it over too (INT on 8.8% of drives) and gets hit (7.9% sacks allowed). The only elite line on our sheet is penalty yards (z +2.52), a rounding error. SP+ bought the blowout wins; we didn't.
hints: Scoreboard outran process: margin rank #14 (margin +108) but SEI #53.
Defense drives the gap: SEI off #45 vs def #66.
SP+ halves: off #17, def #28.
Strongest metrics: Pen yd +2.52.

teams.explanation: A top-five defense attached to a fringe top-30 offense: SEI off #36 / def #4, SP+'s halves off #94 / def #11. The early-down defensive chart is the nation's best on our sheet — opponents average -0.19 PPA on early rushes and passes — and Wisconsin's line almost never gets pushed back (stuff rate 4.9%, 99th percentile) with zero lost fumbles. The scoreboard lags (+55, margin #28) after a 41-13 beatdown at Notre Dame and a 7-17 loss at UCLA. SP+'s #43 is mostly an offense rating.
hints: Process outran scoreboard: margin rank #28 (margin +55) but SEI #10.
Offense drives the gap: SEI off #36 vs def #4.
SP+ halves: off #75, def #14.
Strongest metrics: Stuffed +2.75, Early pass PPA +2.14, Fum% +2.11.
Weakest metrics: Pen -2.47.

teams.explanation: Seven wins, a +33 margin (#48): the scoreboard undersells the process. Kentucky's defense ends 14.1% of opponent drives with a pick — the best number on the board (z +2.76) — while the offense throws one INT all season (1.4% of drives), and opponents manage TDs on just 13.6% of red-zone trips. Yes, 35-34 wins over South Carolina and LSU are squeakers, but the turnover machine behind them isn't luck. SP+'s #45 prices the margin; we price the takeaways.
hints: Process outran scoreboard: margin rank #48 (margin +33) but SEI #13.
SP+ halves: off #31, def #60.
Strongest metrics: INT% +2.76, INT% +2.01, Early rush PPA +1.54.

teams.explanation: SP+ has Tech #7 on a balanced top-15 split (off #8, def #13); our board breaks the tie against the offense at #47. The run game is real (early-down rush PPA z +1.58), but early-down passing (z -0.24) isn't a top-ten unit's chart. The defense (#19, INT% z +2.57) is doing more lifting than SP+ credits, and Cincinnati's 37-24 road loss Saturday is the first result that agrees with us. SP+ is buying the 53-25 and 49-14 blowouts.
hints: Offense drives the gap: SEI off #47 vs def #19.
SP+ halves: off #13, def #12.
Strongest metrics: INT% +2.57, Early rush PPA +1.60, Early rush PPA +1.58.

teams.explanation: We're at #15 because the passing chart is gaudy: early-down pass PPA 0.47 (z +1.56), zero interceptions all season, a 25% red-zone TD rate (95th percentile). SP+'s middling halves (off #35, def #30) put it at #26, and the defensive soft spot is narrow but real: opponents' third-down rush PPA allowed is bottom-five (z -1.90). The +111 margin — Rutgers 42-14, Penn State 34-13 — gets trimmed by SP+ for the 24-21 grind at Michigan State.
hints: Defense drives the gap: SEI off #13 vs def #42.
SP+ halves: off #18, def #27.
Strongest metrics: INT% +1.76, Early pass PPA +1.56.
Weakest metrics: 3rd rush PPA -1.90.
2 of 5 games decided by <=7 pts (SP+ penalizes close wins harder than SEI does).

teams.explanation: 7-0 and SP+ says #10; our sheet says halves in the thirties (off #30, def #34). Utah's real strengths are third-down passing (z +1.66) and early-down rush defense, but the offensive line gets pushed back (stuff rate 10.0%, 9th percentile) and the defense hasn't ended a single opponent drive with a fumble (6th percentile). The 66-14 Idaho tuneup is doing heavy lifting in SP+'s rating math; the marquee win, 31-17 at Iowa State, is good, not #10-grade.
hints: SP+ halves: off #8, def #13.
Strongest metrics: 3rd pass PPA +1.66, Early rush PPA +1.59.
Weakest metrics: Fum% -1.64.

teams.explanation: SEI's split is the story: defense #7, offense #75. The pass rush is genuinely elite — 10.9% sack rate (98th percentile), opponents at 5.9% red-zone TD conversion — while third-down passing (offensive 3rd-down pass PPA z -1.43) sits bottom-ten. SP+'s #13 averages the halves; our composite can't hide the offense. The 26-10 win over Alabama came off the rush, and the 20-17 loss to Texas and 27-24 loss at South Carolina show the ceiling when it cools.
hints: Offense drives the gap: SEI off #75 vs def #7.
SP+ halves: off #21, def #23.
Strongest metrics: Sack% +2.11, RZ TD% +1.80, Stuffed +1.79.

teams.explanation: The small gap, and it favors us: SEI #5, SP+ #12. SP+ is still pricing 20-17 to Georgia and 26-10 at Tennessee; we're pricing a +136 margin with 56-23 at Mississippi State and 49-18 over South Carolina in between. Our sheet loves both run halves — third-down rush PPA z +2.26, opponents' early-down rush PPA z +2.45 — plus an INT rate (11.9% of drives) SP+'s defense number (#23) underweights. Two bad Saturdays keep SP+ away; the tape doesn't.
hints: SP+ halves: off #5, def #16.
Strongest metrics: Early rush PPA +2.45, 3rd rush PPA +2.26, INT% +2.18.

teams.explanation: A gentle disagreement: SEI #9, SP+ #16, and it's all about the passing offense. SP+'s offense rating is #37; ours is #14, built on third down — opponents' third-down pass PPA allowed of -0.30 (99th percentile), offensive third-down pass PPA z +1.52, red-zone finishing z +2.24. The 20-17 loss to Indiana and 14-17 loss at Oregon keep SP+ at arm's length; the efficiency sheet says those were one-score games against good teams, not evidence of a mid-teens team.
hints: SP+ halves: off #22, def #20.
Strongest metrics: 3rd pass PPA +2.24, RZ TD% +2.24, INT% +1.78.
